_schema.description: GSSE question bank for The Differential. Each question hangs off a subtopic_id from gsse_structure.json (the roadmap-style tree). One file may hold many questions, or split per topic/subtopic like the PSA banks.
_schema.join_key: subtopic_id resolves through gsse_config.get_subtopic() to its topic, science (ANATOMY/PHYSIOLOGY/PATHOLOGY) and RACS exam blueprint code(s) — so you never store those redundantly.

fields.id: Unique string. Convention: GSSE-<TOPIC_ID>-<NNNN>, e.g. GSSE-abdomen-0001
fields.subtopic_id: REQUIRED. Leaf id from the tree, e.g. 'abdomen/anterior-abd-wall'. Drives navigation, progress and mock assembly.
fields.topic_label: Optional human label (auto-derivable from subtopic_id; handy for quick reading).
fields.statements: Type X only: list of {text, answer(bool), explanation}. Null otherwise.
fields.options: Type A/B only: list of option strings. Null otherwise.
fields.answer: Type A/B: correct option letter/text. SPOT: canonical answer. Null for Type X.
fields.accepted_answers: SPOT only: acceptable answer variants. Null otherwise.
fields.image: SPOT (or image-stem MCQ): relative path. Null otherwise.
fields.needs_au_review: Bool. Flag regimen/guideline-specific items for Australian Therapeutic Guidelines / QLD Health check.

questions.stem: Regarding the inguinal canal and inguinal hernias:

statements.text: The deep inguinal ring lies lateral to the inferior epigastric vessels.
statements.explanation: Deep ring is a transversalis fascia defect lateral to the inferior epigastric vessels.

statements.text: An indirect inguinal hernia passes medial to the inferior epigastric vessels.
statements.explanation: Indirect = lateral (via deep ring); direct = medial (Hesselbach's triangle).

statements.text: The conjoint tendon is formed by the aponeuroses of internal oblique and transversus abdominis.
statements.explanation: These fuse to reinforce the medial posterior wall.

statements.text: The anterior wall is formed mainly by the external oblique aponeurosis.
The floor of the canal is formed by the external oblique aponeurosis.
statements.explanation: Floor = inguinal ligament with lacunar ligament medially.

questions.explanation: The relation of the sac to the inferior epigastric vessels is the key direct-vs-indirect discriminator.

questions.topic_label: CV Physiology — Heart as a Pump
questions.stem: The dicrotic notch on the aortic pressure waveform corresponds to:
options: A. Opening of the aortic valve
B. Closure of the aortic valve
C. Opening of the mitral valve
D. Closure of the mitral valve
questions.explanation: The incisura marks aortic valve closure at the onset of diastole.

questions.topic_label: Resp Physiology — Gas Transport in Blood

statements.text: A rightward shift indicates decreased haemoglobin affinity for oxygen.
Increased 2,3-DPG shifts the curve to the left.
The Bohr effect describes the influence of CO2 and H+ on oxygen affinity.
Fetal haemoglobin sits to the right of adult haemoglobin.
statements.explanation: HbF has higher affinity — sits left.

statements.text: Carbon monoxide increases oxygen affinity yet reduces oxygen-carrying capacity.
statements.explanation: Shifts left and occupies binding sites.

questions.explanation: Lock down the direction of each shift rather than a single fact.

questions.stem: Regarding the terminology of neoplasia and cellular adaptation:

statements.text: Metaplasia is the reversible replacement of one mature differentiated cell type by another.
statements.explanation: e.g. squamous metaplasia of bronchial epithelium.

statements.text: A hamartoma is a malignant tumour of disorganised tissue.
statements.explanation: Benign, disorganised overgrowth of mature native tissue.

statements.text: Carcinoma in situ has breached the basement membrane.
statements.explanation: By definition it has NOT; invasion defines invasive carcinoma.

statements.text: Anaplasia describes a poorly or undifferentiated tumour.
statements.explanation: Loss of differentiation — a hallmark of malignancy.

statements.text: The TNM system stages by primary size/extent, nodal involvement and distant metastasis.
statements.explanation: T, N, M across organ systems.

questions.explanation: Definitional precision is heavily tested — metaplasia/dysplasia/anaplasia and in-situ vs invasive.

questions.stem: For elective colorectal surgery, surgical antimicrobial prophylaxis should provide cover principally against:
questions.explanation: Colorectal flora are predominantly gram-negative bacilli and anaerobes. Confirm the exact regimen against current Australian Therapeutic Guidelines / local QLD Health policy.

questions.stem: On this axial CT of the thorax at the level of the aortic arch, identify the structure indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: TEMPLATE SPOT — replace the image path with your own asset. Marking matches 'answer' plus 'accepted_answers' (case-insensitive, trimmed). Examiners expect a precisely named structure.
